scope: Exact frozen source/protocol/generated metadata review only. No running FIT payload, unexposed book body, TEST, network acquisition, candidate, build, teacher, fitting, quality run or simulation was read/executed by reviewer.

acquisition_semantics.identity: Source iterates exactly the frozen inline16 validation objects in order, using the pinned generation URL, identity encoding, returned generation equality, bounded raw-byte read, exact advertised length and base64MD5. It preserves raw bytes/SHA and fails on integrity issues without a replacement object/book or selection search.
acquisition_semantics.window: Pinned refresh preprocess performs strict UTF8, CRLF then CR normalization, codepoint midpoint and first following LF rule, unchanged suffix and its SHA. No content/loss-based window selection.
acquisition_semantics.tokenizer: Pinned model-specific native tokenizer on the whole suffix, add_special=true/parse_special=false, no chat template. First512 joint IDs are retained once per model/book; context and continuation are not tokenized separately. Vocab-only invocation does not perform a model forward.
acquisition_semantics.short_window: A shorter result remains an insufficient book; no replacement or token fabrication. The full primary family stays inconclusive.

quality_semantics.runtime: Source observer, B64 and C64 each create fresh own KV under the same512 GT IDs and four128 batches; later-layer routes/states remain native to their own arm. Only Deep L1 or OLM L0 all64 routed expert slots are eligible; source shared/dense/other layers remain their declared source functions.
quality_semantics.earliest_invariant: Every complete book compares all512 actual owned Up inputs, ordered IDs and final actual-MUL alpha bytes against source, using alias-safe bit comparisons. This is a GT earliest-layer source assertion, not a later-layer/rechunking/free-generation identity claim.
quality_semantics.controls: Fixed first book: nohook-observer literal all-vocabulary logits; observer-copyOriginal and9-10/11-12 literal logits plus owned traces. No nonexistent nohook trace or historical checksum is described as actual memcmp. Complete books produce52 fresh contexts/model including four first-book extras.
quality_semantics.scatter_and_alpha: Actual unweighted expert rows are returned through typed run/context/model/mode/epoch/layer/token/slot/expert IPC, then written only to declared Down slices; native final alpha is applied once. Worker/C++ event counts join by book/context/layer/expert/zone, with distinct source-potential, actual replacement, approximation and canonical-fallback counts.
quality_semantics.GT_index: Exactly256 targets256..511 use logits255..510. Input511 is fed and counted separately but its logits are unused. All target IDs are checked against the immutable joint IDs; complete all64 slot totals are255K/256K/K across the three zones.
quality_semantics.coverage_limit: All64 denotes the installed eligible mapping set. Actual held-out expert hits and fallback/approximation exposure must still be reported; this receipt assumes no particular held-out distribution or zero-fallback outcome.

statistics.primary: Two prespecified model C64-minus-B64 paired-book meanNLL endpoints; all16 books,10000 shared resamples, seed2026110304, bootstrapSD ddof1, centered max-abs-T and linear95 cutoff; budget ln1.02.
statistics.decision_separation: Bootstrap-defined and interval-versus-margin relations are separate. Both upper bands below margin indicate only the bounded budget relation; any lower above requires Root+critic fixed-configuration adjudication. Crossing, zero/undefined SD, missing/nonfinite or integrity-invalid results stay inconclusive; no exclusions, redraws, subset inference or automatic failure.
statistics.reference: B64-versus-source and C64-versus-source remain descriptive and separately reviewed. A degraded or invalid canonical reference is not silently attributed to C. Later control replays on these exposed books are secondary/development, not fresh confirmation.

resources_and_identity.ACQUIRE: 1800s whole-phase checkpoint and8e9 research RSS, with existing disk cap/reserve checks.
resources_and_identity.QUALITY: 3600s whole-phase checkpoint and32e9 reference RSS, eight physical cores0-7/same NUMA, one heavy phase and tested pidfd/subreaper cleanup.
resources_and_identity.closure: Runtime registry must bind its complete payload manifest, old/new local archives, canonical weights and frozen geometry. Phase entry verifies all required prior receipts; acquisition and quality independently hash/stat their actual FIT/runtime dependencies before/after and reauthorize after output. Quality also closes acquisition/token IDs. GGUF identity retains its disclosed historical-full-hash/stat bridge.
resources_and_identity.limits: Checkpoints are hard stops, not completion guarantees. Research RSS/IPC/source-overwritten FFN work and harness wall do not establish an8GB deployment, native throughput or whole-DAG speed.

conditions_before_actual_release: FIT must finish and its complete outputs/production/audit/resource/old-artifact identities and final C64 registry must pass the already-required Root+critic fitted-artifact closure review. No such outcome is assumed here.
Root must separately issue ACQUIRE_FRESH16_TOKENIZE approval bound to the unchanged exact source and reviewed FIT/registry hashes.
Only after acquisition/token identity closure may Root separately release QUALITY_C64, bound to FIT, registry and acquisition receipts. No automatic successor or FIT/quality retuning.
scientific_limits: Conditional source approval creates no quality result, complete-model/generation claim, native-flash necessity, >=10% E2E gain or publication success. No new method clock, failure or expanded-control/TEST/push authorization.
